normalizedResult: Persist a binding runtime and private-handoff lifecycle in which every substantive repair or reconstruction creates a new immutable candidate version and delivery remains blocked until that exact version passes a fresh independent audit.

requiredOutcomes.text: Audit evidence and delivery approval are bound to an exact candidate ID, version, and exact-byte digest.
Every substantive reconstruction creates a new immutable child candidate with no inherited audit or delivery approval.
A fresh independent post-reconstruction audit explicitly checks repair-induced errors before delivery.
Self-critique cannot be the sole reconstructed-candidate approval gate and the reconstruction producer cannot certify its own output.
After at most two repair cycles, unresolved substantive/high findings route to the smallest discriminator, explicit uncertainty, or blocked delivery.

Private handoffs preserve current candidate identity, lineage, status, version-bound audit status, prior findings, and the fresh-audit delivery block while keeping handoff, candidate-audit, and reconstruction-audit fidelity distinct.
The de-identified rejection/shame repair regression fails audit-old then reconstruct then deliver, and passes only after a fresh audit of each reconstructed candidate.

nonSatisfyingProxies: the parent candidate passed an audit
the reconstruction writer self-critiqued its own output
a reconstructed candidate reused a parent audit ID
tests pass without runtime delivery enforcement
